description: This script processes the 'symbols-in-versions' file to generate a header file 'libcurl-symbols.h' with macros indicating the minimum and maximum libcurl version levels where specific symbols are present. It facilitates version-aware conditionals in C programs using libcurl.

methods.name: str2num
methods.description: Converts a version string (e.g., '7.72.0') into a hexadecimal number for comparison purposes.

search-terms: Perl script for libcurl symbol versions
